blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–EJ Castillo came up big in overtime as Emilio Aguinaldo College escaped Perpetual Help, 92-89, in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament at San Andres Sports Complex on Friday night. Jude Bagay led the Generals with 26 points, but Castillo sank the crucial shots in the extra period to help EAC improve to 5-6 in Group B. Coach Jerson Cabiltes lauded his streaky shooter, who finished with 15 points, seven rebounds and five assists. “I need to use him because he attracts a lot of the defense.
